name: Wanted: Gath'Ilzogg
summary: In Redridge, Magistrate Solomon offers a generous bounty on the warlord behind Blackrock's invasion of Stonewatch. The reward goes to anyone who storms the conquered keep and brings back the commander's severed head.

sections.title: The Warlord of Stonewatch
sections.body: Gath'Ilzogg commands Blackrock raids across the Redridge Mountains. His orcs stormed Stonewatch Keep and made the former human bastion a fortified staging ground for attacks on nearby settlements. From its highest ramparts, he plans further incursions into Lakeshire, threatening to cut Redridge off from the rest of the kingdom.

sections.title: A Town Pushed to the Brink
sections.body: Stormwind's royal army has failed to send reinforcements to the border regions, so Magistrate Solomon takes matters into his own hands. Lakeshire lacks the soldiers to retake Stonewatch Keep by force. Solomon posts a public bounty on Gath'Ilzogg, hoping to break Blackrock's leadership and begin reclaiming the keep for the crown.

faq.answer: Gath'Ilzogg is an orc warlord leading the Blackrock forces occupying Stonewatch. He directed the keep's conquest and is responsible for frequent deadly raids against Lakeshire's human settlers.
Gath'Ilzogg is entrenched at the top of Stonewatch Keep, in the eastern crags of the Redridge Mountains. Blackrock champions and bodyguards guard him.

faq.q: Why is Magistrate Solomon offering a bounty instead of sending soldiers?
faq.answer: Lakeshire's town guard is stretched thin, and Stormwind's crown has sent no troops to relieve the region. Magistrate Solomon relies on mercenaries and independent adventurers to face major threats.

faq.q: What happens after Gath'Ilzogg is killed?
faq.answer: Magistrate Solomon sees Gath'Ilzogg's death as the first step toward clearing out the orcs and, eventually, reclaiming Stonewatch Keep for the Kingdom of Stormwind. Blackrock forces remain heavy in the region.

faq.q: Why did the Blackrock orcs invade Stonewatch Keep?
faq.answer: The Blackrock clan uses Stonewatch Keep as a fortified forward base high in the Redridge Mountains. From there, they control the passes and launch raids against human settlements.

faq.q: Who claims the bounty once Gath'Ilzogg is dead?
faq.answer: Bring Gath'Ilzogg's head to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire's town hall as proof of his defeat.

angles.text: Striking down Gath'Ilzogg removes one of the most immediate military threats to the kingdom's eastern borders and buys vital breathing room for Lakeshire's citizens.
For Stormwind's people, Stonewatch Keep was hard won. Gath'Ilzogg's slaughter of innocents when it fell makes this bounty a matter of bitter vengeance.
At Stonewatch Keep's summit, you face the hardened veteran warriors and brute strength of the Dark Horde's frontline command.
